summary: KIZILKAN PLAYER FAZ 4 (Ultimate) tested end-to-end on mobile viewport 390x844 and tablet 768x1024. BACKEND: 19/19 pytest tests pass (full FAZ 2+3 regression — no new endpoints in FAZ 4, all previous still healthy). FRONTEND FAZ 4 NEW: (1) Enhanced KIZILKAN logo verified — onboarding shows huge red KIZILKAN with crescent-moon-in-circle badge and '★ PLAYER ★' subtitle (matches spec); compact kizilkan-logo testID present in Live TV header. (2) Player.tsx no longer force-locks landscape: player-rotate-btn present in top bar, cycled 3× (auto→landscape→portrait→auto) with no crash. All previous player controls (back/playpause/audio/subtitle/sleep/seek/fit) still present. (3) /multi-view route working: mv-back-btn, mv-layout-2, mv-layout-4 all functional; layout switch renders mv-add-2/mv-add-3 slots for 4-view; channel picker modal opened, showed 130 selectable channels (mv-pick-*); after picking a channel, VideoView renders and mv-audio-0 toggles between 'SES AÇIK'/'SESSİZ'. Screen orientation locks landscape on enter and restores portrait on back. (4) /epg-timeline route working: header calendar btn (open-epg-timeline-btn) navigates to epg-timeline-screen showing KANAL column + hourly cells 07:00/08:00… + channel logos; empty cells expected (no EPG loaded for this playlist). (5) /backup route working: do-export-btn + do-import-btn visible with red brand styling; Google Drive info card ('Publish sonrası') visible. Renders correctly on both mobile and tablet width. (6) DVR info modal working: feature-dvr-btn opens modal titled 'Kayıt Alma (DVR)' with 'Anladım' button; dvr-info-ok-btn dismisses. (7) Settings section 'GELİŞMİŞ ÖZELLİKLER' renders all 4 new entries (Çoklu Ekran / 7 Günlük TV Rehberi / Yedekleme / Kayıt Alma(DVR) YAKINDA badge). FRONTEND REGRESSION: onboarding→add-playlist→206 iptv-org channels parsed and loaded; Live TV tab renders channel list, segmented control, favorites, category chips; theme picker shows Netflix/Türk Bayrağı/Modern/Vu IPTV — all intact. NO red-screen crashes. NO console errors (excluding pre-existing react-native-web pointerEvents/resizeMode deprecation warnings). All Turkish text preserved. Orientation restored to portrait when leaving player and multi-view.

ui_bugs.issue: State variable `search` is declared and used in filteredChannels memo (lines 25,33-39), but there is NO TextInput rendered in the picker modal to update it — the search feature is dead code. Users cannot filter the 130+ channel picker. Reference: /app/frontend/app/multi-view.tsx:25,89-117 (modal body has FlatList only, no search input).

react_native_issues.issue: Console still emits 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' and 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated' warnings, same as iterations 1/2/3. Non-blocking, likely originating from Expo Router / @expo/vector-icons internals on react-native-web. No code change requested — carry-forward note only.

action_items: OPTIONAL LOW: Add a TextInput in /app/frontend/app/multi-view.tsx picker modal to actually update the `search` state, or remove the dead search state to simplify. Currently, filtering works only via the (unused) state — no way to type from UI. Not blocking; picker still displays first 200 channels and pick works.
OPTIONAL (carry-forward from FAZ 3): silence react-native-web pointerEvents/resizeMode deprecation warnings once expo/vector-icons upgrade path is available.

OPTIONAL: server.py (~800 lines) and settings.tsx (~639 lines) approach the 700-line threshold. If FAZ 5 adds more endpoints/screens, split settings.tsx into section components (ThemeSection, ParentalSection, FeaturesSection) and server.py into modules (m3u/xtream/stalker/epg).
critical_code_review_comments: player.tsx correctly uses ScreenOrientation.unlockAsync() on mount (line 117) and locks to PORTRAIT_UP on unmount/back (lines 122,207) — no orientation lock leaks confirmed.
player-rotate-btn cycles orientation modes correctly: 'auto' → unlockAsync, 'landscape' → LANDSCAPE, 'portrait' → PORTRAIT_UP (lines 129-131). Tested 3-click cycle with no crash.
multi-view.tsx locks LANDSCAPE on mount and restores PORTRAIT on unmount cleanup (lines 27-30). Back button also explicitly restores portrait (lines 52-55).

multi-view Slot component muted-toggle uses `(player as any).muted = !isAudio` cast (line 131) — works because expo-video's VideoPlayer.muted exists as a property but may not be typed on older SDK. Consider using volume=0 fallback in a native build.
expo-video useVideoPlayer called with null url in empty multi-view slots (line 127) — expo-video does handle null source gracefully; no crash observed. Good.
KizilkanLogo.tsx (~102 lines) uses Ionicons for crescent moon and pure StyleSheet — no native fonts required. Animated fade+scale entrance is via Animated API. testID='kizilkan-logo' consistently.
useResponsive hook (48 lines) computes {isPhone, isTablet, isLandscape, posterColumns} — PosterGrid consumes posterColumns and adapts (3 phone / 5 tablet-portrait / 6 tablet-landscape) as spec'd.
backup.ts uses expo-clipboard on web + expo-sharing on native, with expo-document-picker for import. Correct platform gating.
All new routes registered in _layout.tsx (multi-view, epg-timeline, backup) with correct 'orientation: default' or 'presentation: modal' options.
No new backend endpoints in FAZ 4 — all 19 legacy endpoints regressed and passing.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all FAZ 4 flows verified; 1 LOW cosmetic finding — dead search state in multi-view picker)

rca_of_issue: No functional bugs found. One cosmetic LOW finding: multi-view.tsx has `const [search, setSearch] = useState('')` and filters channels by it in filteredChannels memo, but the channel picker modal (Modal ... pickerBg) contains only a FlatList and no TextInput wired to setSearch. Reproduction: enter Live TV → open-multi-view-btn → tap mv-add-0 → picker modal opens with 130-200 channels; no search field visible. Mitigation: add <TextInput testID='mv-picker-search' value={search} onChangeText={setSearch} placeholder='Kanal ara...' /> above the FlatList inside pickerCard.
